name: academic-writing-marketplace
description: Local marketplace bundling the latest nature-skills, academic-research-skills (ARS), writing-quality skills, and research-planning skills.

plugins.name: nature-skills
plugins.description: 22+ Nature-standard academic skills: research writing & proposals, polishing, reviewer simulation, statistics, citation retrieval/verification, data availability, figures, paper reading/translation, reviewer responses, slides.

plugins.name: research-planning
plugins.description: Research-lifecycle planning: literature-triage-matrix (compare a paper set), gap-to-topic (3-gate go/no-go on a thesis topic), research-design-helper (Socratic study design), research-context-compressor (persist context across sessions), paper-memory-builder (claim/evidence memory). Prompt-only, no Zotero/CLI.

plugins.name: physics-thesis-revision
plugins.description: 理论物理与量子信息方向中文学位论文的改稿技能：逐段主旨与段间逻辑诊断、摘要与第一章绪论结构、主张—证据审计。原创改写，例子按子系统量子 Fisher 信息与纠缠判据重写。

plugins.name: thesis-night-run
plugins.description: 中文学位论文的夜间批处理与人工介入分级：T1 可自动、T2 可自动但需复核、Gated 必须等人；生成夜间任务清单与晨报，只写候选目录，不碰正式稿与决策记录。

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Remove AI tells (humanizer, humanizer-zh) and reduce defensive/hedged writing (anti-defensive-writing, anti-defensive-writing-zh). Full versions.

plugins.name: academic-research-skills
plugins.description: ARS v3.23.0 — production-grade research → write → review → revise pipeline. 5 skills, 35+ modes, Material Passport pipeline.
